name: DuckDuckGo
priceNote: Browser, search, Email Protection and App Tracking Protection are free. Removal runs on your device, not on remote servers.
brokerCountLabel: Not stated on official site — the official list page names sites individually with no total; 'The exact number of sites may change over time as we add or remove data broker sites from this list'
rescanLabel: "Check every 10 days" — fastest official rescan in this comparison

features.label: Broker scan
features.norton: Yes — scans supported people-search & data broker sites and shows which have your data
features.rival: Yes — Personal Information Removal, submitted from your device

features.label: Automated removal included
features.norton: No — included Privacy Monitor is manual opt-out. Automated removal only with Privacy Monitor Assistant add-on, $109.99/yr or $12.99/mo
features.rival: Yes — submits opt-outs for you, included in Plus/Pro

features.label: Broker count stated
features.norton: Page by page on norton.com — the Privacy Monitor Assistant product page (us.norton.com/products/privacy-monitor-assistant) says 'over 2,000' data broker sites; the Privacy Monitor feature page (us.norton.com/feature/privacy-monitor) says 'over 200'; the support list names sites individually with no total. Used in this comparison: 'over 2,000' from the Assistant product page on the main site — the Assistant is the removal product. No staging page is used as a source anywhere in this comparison
features.note: Norton's Privacy Monitor Assistant product page (us.norton.com/products/privacy-monitor-assistant) says 'over 2,000' data broker sites; the Privacy Monitor feature page (us.norton.com/feature/privacy-monitor) says 'They target over 200 data broker sites and databases.'; the support list (support.norton.com) names sites individually with no total. DuckDuckGo prints no total broker count on its official pages.
features.rival: Not stated on official site — named list only, no total stated

features.label: Rescan speed
features.norton: Every 90 days (Privacy Monitor Assistant); Privacy Monitor scan re-run every 3 months

features.label: Custom removal requests
features.norton: Offered via Reputation Defender executive/corporate products only (quote-led, 'when possible', no published price, no consumer product): ExecutivePrivacy — “Custom removal requests, when possible”; Total Radius — “Custom Data Removals”; VIP Services — “Deep Web privacy protection, including custom removal requests”. No Norton consumer product offers custom removals — Privacy Monitor Assistant covers its supported broker list only

features.label: Google results removal
features.norton: Yes — via Reputation Defender (separate purchase, reputationdefender.com): “Push negative content or misleading search results down to pages where virtually nobody will ever see them”; its FAQ: “in certain cases online content in your search results can be permanently deleted”. Reputation Defender suppresses negative content in search results and deletes content where possible — it does not make de-indexing requests to Google

features.label: Removal proof
features.norton: Results list + opt-out tracking; email once a batch of opt-outs has been sent. Screenshots: Not stated on official site
features.rival: Dashboard notes for closed records — formal report: Not stated on official site. Screenshots: Not stated on official site

features.label: Tracker & cookie blocking
features.norton: Yes — Tracker & Cookie Blocking (support). Full ad blocking: Not stated on official site ('limit targeted ads')
features.rival: Yes — blocks 3rd-party trackers. Detailed cookie wording: Not stated on official site

features.label: Fingerprint protection
features.norton: "Disguise your digital fingerprint automatically each time you browse" — support: anti-fingerprinting will 'return dummy data' to websites
features.rival: Yes — “we block many fingerprinting scripts before they can even load… we override many of the browser APIs used for fingerprinting to make them return either no information or alternative information that's less useful for fingerprinting” (duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/privacy/web-tracking-protections, verified 12 Nov 2026)

features.label: Email aliases + tracker blocking
features.norton: Yes — create unlimited email aliases (AntiTrack Private Email) and block hidden email trackers
features.rival: Yes, free — Email Protection creates unlimited unique private addresses and 'removes multiple types of hidden email trackers'

features.label: App / OS-level protection
features.norton: Yes — Windows OS Tracker Blocking: blocks tracking activities and targeted ads by the Windows operating system (support)
features.rival: Yes, free — App Tracking Protection (Android) 'helps block 3rd-party trackers in your apps, even when you're not using them'

features.label: Tracking dashboard
features.norton: Yes — Tracking Dashboard shows real-time blocked trackers, ranked by level of concern / risk

partials.detail: Norton offers automated removal via Privacy Monitor Assistant ($109.99/yr add-on/standalone, agents handle removals from over 2,000 broker sites) - not included in any Norton 360 with LifeLock suite; LifeLock Core includes automatic removal from 60 sites only. DuckDuckGo includes it in Plus/Pro. Mechanism differs: DuckDuckGo runs on-device (your info stays on your device); PMA is agent-led.
partials.name: Personal Information Removal

nortonEvidence.note: $109.99/yr or $12.99/mo; add-on to 360/LifeLock plans or standalone; agents handle removal requests.
nortonEvidence.quote: Take control of your data with Privacy Monitor Assistant, which removes your personal information from over 2,000 data broker sites and databases. We'll do the work for you.

nortonEvidence.note: Automatic data broker removal (60 sites, 90-day rescan) included in LifeLock Core; distinct from full PMA.
nortonEvidence.quote: Once you add your details, we scan 60 data broker sites for your personal information and automatically remove your data.

partials.rivalHowSold: Included in Plus and Pro subscriptions (US residents only)
partials.rivalQuote: It scans for your info on data broker sites around the web, requests its removal on sites that support removal requests, and receives and handles confirmation emails for you. It then scans these sites on a regular schedule to help minimize the risk of your information reappearing. Unlike other services, every step of the automated removal process happens entirely on your device, not remote servers.

partials.detail: Norton offers OS-level tracker blocking only on Windows; Android in-app tracker blocking is not stated.
partials.name: App Tracking Protection

nortonEvidence.quote: The Windows OS Tracker blocking feature in Norton AntiTrack helps you keep your online activities private by blocking tracking and targeted advertising from the Windows operating system.

partials.rivalQuote: App Tracking Protection, currently available in our Android browser, that helps block 3rd-party trackers in your other apps, even when you're not using them.

partials.detail: Norton offers unlimited email aliases via a separate Norton add-on (Windows/Mac only); DuckDuckGo Email Protection is free with unlimited aliases, cross-platform.
partials.name: Email Protection

nortonEvidence.note: Windows/Mac only; part of a paid Norton add-on.
nortonEvidence.quote: Create unlimited email aliases and block hidden email trackers, all without changing your current provider (Windows, Mac).

partials.rivalQuote: DuckDuckGo Email Protection is a free email forwarding service that removes multiple types of hidden email trackers and lets you create unlimited unique private email addresses on the fly.

partials.detail: Same data cleared, different format. DuckDuckGo's Fire Button burns recent on-device browsing data in one click — that one click is its defining feature. Norton's free Private Browser Privacy Cleaner clears the same data (browsing history, cached images, cookies), but as a multi-step flow, in the Norton Private Browser FAQ's own wording: open Norton Private Browser and go to the Security & Privacy Center, tap Advanced Settings, tap Clear next to 'Clear all Cookies & data', then tap Clear to confirm. One click vs several steps — PARTIAL (user-approved flip, 12 Nov 2026).
partials.name: Fire Button

nortonEvidence.note: Free, built into the browser. The same FAQ page gives the multi-step flow: 'Open Norton Private Browser and go to the Security & Privacy Center. Tap Advanced Settings and then tap Clear next to Clear all Cookies & data.' — then 'Tap Clear to confirm.' Not one click.
nortonEvidence.quote: Privacy Cleaner clears your browsing history and other data stored in your browsers, such as cached images and cookies.

partials.rivalQuote: The Fire Button, which allows you to easily burn recent on-device browsing data in one click.
